reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per activation event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS prev_ts
  FROM activation_events
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per activation event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
)
SELECT user_id, CAST(event_ts AS DATE) AS event_day, SUM(new_session) AS sessions
FROM flagged
WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY user_id, CAST(event_ts AS DATE)
HAVING SUM(new_session) >= 2

WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per activation event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS prev_ts
  FROM activation_events
)
SELECT user_id, CAST(event_ts AS DATE) AS event_day, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM gaps
WHERE (prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes')
  AND event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY user_id, CAST(event_ts AS DATE)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session start
  SELECT e.user_id, CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE) AS event_day
  FROM activation_events e
  WHERE e.event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND e.event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM activation_events p
      WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
        AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_name < e.event_name))
        AND p.event_ts >= e.event_ts - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
    )
)
SELECT user_id, event_day, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM starts
GROUP BY user_id, event_day
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

GROUP BY user_id, event_day
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
other_way.tradeoff: Listing the session starts with NOT EXISTS before counting them works too, but it searches each user's events again for every event.

solver.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM activation_events WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name)),
s AS (SELECT *, SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS sn FROM f),
ss AS (SELECT user_id, sn, MIN(event_ts) AS st, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY user_id, sn) SELECT user_id, CAST(st AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) AS event_day, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM ss WHERE st >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND st < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
